result.topic_en: Change of variables to characteristic coordinates p, q in a second-order (wave-type) partial differential equation for u(x,t), with a substitution u = e^{s} u' to remove first-derivative terms.
result.transcription:
$f(t^p \zeta, t^q \zeta)$ \quad $4\frac{\partial \log \Theta(q)}{\partial \log q} = \left(\frac{\partial^2\Theta}{\partial v^2}\right)_0$
$\frac{\partial u}{\partial t} = \frac{\partial u}{\partial p} + \frac{\partial u}{\partial q}$
[-$\Theta$-]
$\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial t^2} = \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial p^2} + 2\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial p\partial q} + \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial q^2}$ \quad $\varrho\, \kappa \frac{\partial \kappa'}{\kappa\, \partial \kappa}$[?]
$\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial p} - \frac{\partial u}{\partial q}\right)\zeta'$
$\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2} - \zeta'^2 \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial t^2} = -4\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial p\partial q}\zeta'^2 + \left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial p} - \frac{\partial u}{\partial q}\right)\zeta''$
$\frac{\partial u}{\partial p} - \frac{\partial u}{\partial q} + \frac{\partial u}{\partial p} - \frac{\partial u}{\partial q}$
$+ 2s' u$
[-$u = e^{s} u'$-] \quad $u = e^{s} u'$
$\frac{\partial u}{\partial p} = \left(\frac{\partial u'}{\partial p} + s' u'\right) e^{s}$
[-$\frac{\partial u}{\partial p} = e$-]
$\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial p\partial q} = \left(\frac{\partial^2 u'}{\partial p\partial q} + s'\left(-\frac{\partial u'}{\partial p} + \frac{\partial u'}{\partial q}\right) - s'^2 u'\right)$ \quad $\frac{\partial u}{\partial q} = \left(\frac{\partial u'}{\partial q} - s' u'\right) e^{s}$

methods.what: Heat-equation relation for theta function: derivative of log Theta with respect to log q equals second derivative in v at 0
Chain rule for transformation to characteristic variables p, q (time derivative)
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial u}{\partial t} = \frac{\partial u}{\partial p} + \frac{\partial u}{\partial q}$

methods.what: Second time derivative in characteristic variables
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial t^2} = \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial p^2} + 2\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial p\partial q} + \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial q^2}$

methods.what: Space derivative in characteristic variables with x-dependent scale zeta'
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial p} - \frac{\partial u}{\partial q}\right)\zeta'$

methods.what: Wave operator reduced to characteristic (normal) form with first-order term
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2} - \zeta'^2 \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial t^2} = -4\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial p\partial q}\zeta'^2 + \left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial p} - \frac{\partial u}{\partial q}\right)\zeta''$

methods.what: Substitution u = e^s u' to eliminate first-order derivative terms
Derivatives of u after exponential substitution
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial u}{\partial p} = \left(\frac{\partial u'}{\partial p} + s' u'\right) e^{s}$

methods.what: Mixed second derivative after exponential substitution
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial p\partial q} = \left(\frac{\partial^2 u'}{\partial p\partial q} + s'\left(-\frac{\partial u'}{\partial p} + \frac{\partial u'}{\partial q}\right) - s'^2 u'\right)$
